# Portage Park Animal Hospital & Dental Clinic

> > A full-service veterinary hospital and dental clinic in Chicago offering comprehensive pet healthcare from preventive wellness to surgical and end-of-life care.

Portage Park Animal Hospital & Dental Clinic is a trusted veterinary practice located at 5419 West Irving Park Road in Chicago, serving the Portage Park, Logan Square, and Albany Park communities. The hospital provides comprehensive veterinary and dental services for cats and dogs, including preventive care, diagnostics, surgery, and specialized treatments.

## Key Topics

- Veterinary services
- Pet dental care
- Wellness exams
- Vaccinations (Rabies, Distemper)
- Surgical services
- Spay/neuter
- Digital radiographic diagnostics
- Dermatology
- Lab services
- End-of-life care
- Chicago veterinary clinic
- Appointment booking
- Pet healthcare
- Preventive care
